resolution.note: Weights refreshed from runs 42527483119..42529731081; simulated slowest shard 20.3 -> 12.8; orphan isolation-gate.d.mts removed.

title: Rebalance CI test shards on current per-file medians
body:
Outcome: the slowest Test shard p50 drops below the 18 s target of scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs (24.8 s on main at 039a1c7: shard 10/10 against a 16 s mean). The weights in scripts/lib/shard-weights.mjs came from older runs, and 31 files now run more than 30% over their weight (scope-bypass 11.4 s against 4.4 s).
Proof: a simulated plan (parallel sum / 4 lanes + serial, scored on the new medians) puts the slowest shard at 12.8 instead of 20.3. After the merge, run node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --runs 5 on main.
Also: remove scripts/isolation-gate.d.mts, whose .mjs was retired in t-bs9wgcr.
